prose: Anthropic announced the donation of the Agent Skills open standard to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation, saying 70+ platforms have adopted it - the formal announcement of the move Simon Willison reported yesterday. Anthropic's own page frames it alongside its public-benefit mission and the Haiku 5.5 launch.
highlights: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation)
Anthropic says 70+ platforms have adopted the standard
Formal announcement of the donation Willison flagged a day earlier
basis: Basis: source cache captured Anthropic's homepage rather than the announcement text; note built from the Techmeme feed title and the adjacent Willison report.
